hooks.command:
cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""')
deny() { jq -n --arg r "Git workflow guard [$1]: $2" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:$r}}'; exit 0; }
# One simple command per line: join line continuations, split at && || ; | ` and newlines, and drop quotes so "main" reads as main.
segments=$(printf '%s\n' "$cmd" | sed -E ':a;N;$!ba;s/\\\n/ /g' | sed -E 's/&&|\|\||;|\||`/\n/g; s/["'"'"']//g')
branch=$(git -C "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" branch --show-current 2>/dev/null)
while IFS= read -r seg; do
  seg=$(printf '%s' "$seg" | sed -E 's/^[[:space:]]+//; s/[[:space:]]+$//')
  g() { printf '%s' "$seg" | grep -Eq -- "$1"; }
  if g '(^|[[:space:]])gh[[:space:]]+pr[[:space:]]+merge([[:space:]]|$)'; then
    deny pr-merge "\`$seg\`: merging pull requests is the owner's decision. Ask the user to merge."
  fi
  g '(^|[[:space:]])git([[:space:]]+(-[Cc][[:space:]]+[^[:space:]]+|-[^[:space:]]+))*[[:space:]]+push([[:space:]]|$)' || continue
  advice="Push a feature branch and open a pull request."
  if g '(^|[[:space:]])(-[a-z]*f[a-z]*|--force|--force-with-lease|--force-if-includes)([[:space:]=]|$)|[[:space:]]\+'; then
    deny push-force "\`$seg\` would rewrite history on the remote. $advice"
  fi
  if g '(^|[[:space:]])(-[a-z]*d[a-z]*|--delete|--prune)([[:space:]=]|$)|[[:space:]]:[^[:space:]]+([[:space:]]|$)'; then
    deny push-delete "\`$seg\` would delete a ref on the remote. $advice"
  fi
  if g '(^|[[:space:]])(--all|--branches|--mirror)([[:space:]=]|$)'; then
    deny push-all "\`$seg\` would push every branch, main among them. $advice"
  fi
  if g '(^|[[:space:]])(--tags|--follow-tags)([[:space:]=]|$)|refs/tags|[[:space:]]v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+'; then
    deny push-tags "\`$seg\` would push a tag. $advice"
  fi
  if g '(^|[[:space:]:])((refs/)?heads/|refs/[^[:space:]]+/)?main([[:space:]]|$)'; then
    deny push-to-main "\`$seg\` would update main on the remote. $advice"
  fi
  if [ "$branch" = main ]; then
    deny push-from-main "\`$seg\` runs with main checked out. Create a feature branch before pushing."
  fi
done <<< "$segments"
exit 0
